{{Quote|The main body of insurgents would focus fire on the primary threat&hellip;while the Jedi would commence with rapid elimination of soft targets.|Oniye Namada describes the insurgent tactics|<ref name="P:TF1" />}}
During the [[Vaklin insurgency]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]], [[Valkin insurgents|insurgent]] forces '''ambushed''' a patrol being carried out by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ambush took place in the [[Howling Ruins]], where the insurgent forces, led by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cho'na Bene]], reigned down fire on the Imperials, led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] as they passed through. Both sides sustained heavy casualties in the following clash, although both commanders survived to fight again. After Bene revealed himself to Vader and the fell back into nearby caverns, the surviving Imperials retreated too instead of following him.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|At approximately 0700 hours (local), Lord Vader and two enforcer squads proceeded from central command to the Howling Ruins.|Oniye Namada reports on the beginning of Vader's patrol|<ref name="P:TF1" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an [[Valkin insurgents|insurgency]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arose on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]]. The [[Vaklin insurgency]] was instigated by three members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which had been betrayed and almost entirely destroyed by the Empire as a part of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. As part of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself traveled to Valkin to fight the insurgents and soon killed [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Shrokaan)|one]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and imprisoned [[Unidentified reptilian Jedi Knight|another]]. After the capture of the second Jedi, the insurgents harassed the Imperials for 12 [[Standard day/Legends|days]], led by the final Jedi, [[Cho'na Bene]]. On the twelfth day, at approximatley 0700 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] local time, Vader led a patrol out of the Imperial [[Command center (Vaklin)|command center]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vaklin Zenith]], with the intention of killing or arresting Bene. The patrol included two enforcer squads of [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], a [[TX-130 Fighter Tank]] and at least one [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]], and was led, beside Vader, by a [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone trooper commander]]. The group entered the [[Howling Ruins]] at approximately 0930 hours local time, at which point some of the clone troopers, including [[CT-3632]], were preforming a perimeter sweep ahead of the group. Those preforming the sweep found no activity in the area, and 3632 reported this back to [[CT-3636]], who ordered him to change the perimeter distance and continue looking. Despite this report, forces of the Vaklin insurgency including Bene, were in fact hidden through out the ruins, laying in wait for the Imperials.<ref name="P:TF1" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Goodbye, fair hovertank!|Oniye Namada reports on the battle's start|<ref name="P:TF1" />}}
At approximately 0930 hours local time, just as the Imperial patrol entered the Howling Ruins, the insurgents opened fire on them from above. Shooting from within the ruins, the insurgents killed several clones including CT-3636, although Vader defended others using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]]. Bene, who was hidden nearby in the ruins, waited until Vader was pinned down by an explosion and then sprung forth in to action, killing two troopers aiming to help the Sith. The insurgents then maintained fire on Vader, keeping his attention, whilst the Jedi destroyed the Imperial's [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] and [[Hovertank|hover tank]]. The tank's destruction acted as a signal to the insurgents in the ruins to retreat, throwing [[pyro grenade]]s as they did to provide cover. Vader killed several of the insurgents as they attempted to escape by preventing one grenade from being thrown before it exploded. Bene then confronted Vader and complimented him before offering him peace, after which he immediately retreated into a nearby set of caverns, hoping to draw Vader and his men in after him.<ref name="P:TF1" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|There will be no pursuit.|Vader stops his men from chasing Bene|<ref name="P:TF1" />}}
As Bene withdrew the clone commander informed Vader that twelve troopers had been killed in total, but that the survivors could still give pursuit of the Jedi. The Sith saw Bene's intention though, and at approximatley 0100 hours local time, ordered a retreat, knowing that pursuing the Jedi further from the city into the hazardous caverns would be deadly for the Imperials to attempt. The Imperials fell back as ordered back to the command center, where they were later [[Attack on the Imperial command center|attacked]] by the insurgents, in the hope of freeing the Jedi prisoner kept there. The details of the ambush were later recorded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] in a report titled [[I-1807-VAK]].<ref name="P:TF1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ambush first appeared in [[2012]] in [[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 1|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 1]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] in the [[Purge (comic book)|''Star Wars: Purge'']] series. The comic was written by [[Alexander Freed]] and pencilled by [[Marco Castiello]] and [[Andrea Chella]].
